subsection.title: Screen Inventory
subsection.description: - List only screens required by the Primary User Scenario and approved Features. - Reference the Feature IDs each screen supports. - State the core ideal use case action, screen purpose, essential information, and Primary Persona actions.

subsection.title: Navigation
subsection.description: Describe how the Primary Persona moves between the listed screens while completing the core ideal use cases.

subsection.title: Screen States
subsection.description: Optional. Describe only the visible states that the PoC actually presents. Do not add error or edge states solely to complete the template.
